The above referenced contractis amended or modified as setforthin the following and these amendments
and modifications of the plans and specifications are agreed to by the parties.All other aspects of the
original agreement remain unchanged and in full force and effect.
I. Description of Changes
This modification modifies Contract No.5921 with Reiman Corporation to add an additional block(600
East)of repaving to the E.Pershing Blvd.Reconstruction Project to address several significant potholes
just outside of the current project limits.The extension in project limits has been approved by the Federal
Highway Administration andWYDOT.This modification also changesthe gradation on the asphalt oil to
polymer modified oil, which should yield increased pavement life.This project was originally set upwith
pay items for fuel and oil adjustment, whereby the risk of changes in oil prices is shared between the City
and the Contractor. The Contractor declined the option for the fuel adjustment. This modification
eliminates the pay items for thefuel adjustment and applies themoney saved against the total cost of this
modification.
